name: CineStream
description: One stop solution for Movies, Series, Anime, AsianDrama and Torrents (includes CineAnime: AniList + TMDB + AnimePahe). v535: Two new Cloudflare Bypass controls in Settings - 'Check cookies' and 'Clear all cookies' - both D-pad navigable for Android TV. Check sends one request with the saved cookie and UA and reports Valid / Invalid / No cookie / Couldn't check (a network error is never shown as valid). Clear removes every saved cookie and timestamp for all bypass hosts, purges clearance cookies from the shared WebView jar, and resets the in-memory validation window so playback probes immediately instead of scraping with nothing. Clearing uses a two-step press (no extra dialog) and the Clear button stays in place, greyed out, so TV focus does not jump. All v534 Cloudflare fixes retained.
